name: Aerospace Wire & Cable Inc
old_description: Specialized Manufacturers of High-Performance Custom High-Temperature Wire & Cable Solutions
about:
Aerospace Wire & Cable Inc. operates from College Point in the Flushing section of Queens, New York. The company was founded in 1986 and has specialized in high-temperature wire and cable for nearly four decades. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm designs and manufactures custom high-performance wire and cable, covering communication, signal, coaxial, data, low-capacitance, fire alarm, instrumentation, tray, thermocouple, RTD, and hook-up constructions. Production runs from extrusion through jacketing, with AWG sizes ranging from 4/0 to 30, voltage ratings up to 1,000 V, and a temperature span of –80 °C to +300 °C. Insulation materials include FEP, foamed FEP, ETFE, PFA, PTFE, Kapton, LS-PVC, ECTFE, PEEK, and ECA 3000. The company also offers a custom cable worksheet for engineered designs.

Products serve aerospace, appliance, communications, data/telecom, fire safety, industrial instrumentation, and temperature-measurement markets. The company maintains UL Listed approvals for Type Z, ZW, and PFAH cables and provides cross-reference lookups for Belden, Berk-Tek, and West Penn part numbers.

Aerospace Wire & Cable positions itself as a leader in custom high-temperature cable manufacturing, emphasizing a broad insulation portfolio, wide temperature range, and UL-listed designs that meet demanding aerospace and industrial specifications.

Agility Engineering & Manufacturing Solutions is headquartered in St. Paul, Minnesota. Founded in 1952, the company has operated as a 100% employee-owned organization since its inception.

Its custom capabilities include UL508 panel assembly, wire harness fabrication, and CSA/UL-certified component repackaging, alongside supply chain management services that allow customers to consolidate vendors. The company also operates an online shopping cart stocked with brands such as 3M, Paktron, Mechanical Products, Trumeter, and Solico.

Agility serves manufacturers in agriculture (mobility controls for farm machinery), medical technology (sensing equipment for hospital-grade instruments), and IoT infrastructure. Longtime customers include Brink’s Mfg. Co. and Birk Manufacturing, which rely on the company for critical lifesaving components and competitive pricing.

The company emphasizes its HEART values—Honest communication, Evolution through innovation, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork—as the foundation of its client relationships. name: Akrion Technologies
old_description: Our legacy of over 30 years in the semiconductor industry is built on delivering cutting-edge wet process technologies that drive your success. Discover how our expertise can transform your operations.
about:
Akrion Technologies is headquartered in Allentown, Pennsylvania. With over 30 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, the company has established itself as a supplier of advanced wafer surface preparation solutions. Ownership details and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and manufactures automated wet stations for clean and strip processes, including the GAMA fully automated wet station, the PINNACLE SERIES cassetteless wet stations, and the V3 compact wet station. These systems handle 100 mm to 300 mm substrates in batches of 25 or 50 wafers, processing materials such as silicon, silicon carbide, glass, and sapphire. Akrion also provides CVD, etch, furnace, and off-line process tools. The company reports more than 300 tools delivered, over 100 customers served, and a presence in five global locations.

Akrion serves the global microelectronics industry, with a focus on analog IC, digital IC, power IC, MEMS, and R&D technology markets. Its equipment is used by customers for both research and production on bare or patterned substrates.

The company emphasizes customizable modular batch immersion solutions backed by full technical support, including installation, maintenance, advanced process assistance, training, parts repair, system upgrades, and 24-hour phone support. A continuous improvement program aims to reduce installation times and deliver reliable product performance.
